notes: Read the web source line by line. Preserved the WinnerSemantic / ComparisonRow types (source L37-46), getWinner (L50-54) and the winnerCell semantics (L56-68) — the web emerald-300 winner colour + ' ✓' suffix becomes the native <WinnerValue> (colors.success + ' ✓', loser primary-toned). BANNER_DISMISSED_KEY (L73) is preserved as a module const, with localStorage dismissal (L256-262, L263-270) reproduced by a module-level session flag bannerDismissedSession (AsyncStorage is not wired); the banner still defaults visible and hides on dismiss.

VehicleStatusCard (source L77-213) ported verbatim: the isLoading Skeleton lines={5} branch -> 5 native placeholder bars; the !vehicle EmptyState (Car icon + comparison.selectVehicle) -> native EmptyState + leading SemanticIcon 'vehicle'; batteryLevel/range/insideTemp/outsideTemp/isOnline derivations (L108-112) verbatim; the battery bar colour thresholds (>50 green, >20 amber, else red, min(level,100)% width, L142-150) -> ProportionBar with colors.success/warning/danger; Range formatDistance(range) (L159), Temperature inside/outside formatTemperature (L170-171), Security is_locked/sentry_mode (L182-196) and the Status pill vehicle.state ?? 'Unknown' (L205-208) all preserved with the exact comparison.* keys + defaults.

Main component (source L217-499): usePageTitle(comparison.title) (L220) -> on-screen header (no native tab-title analogue). useUnits/useFormatting/useChartPalette (L222-243) reproduced by reading native useSettings() and deriving distance/speed/temperature prefs from unit_of_length/unit_of_temp, currencySymbol, locale, decimal precision (userPrecision default 2 + unitPrecision via derivePrecision) and the CB-safe-vs-neon palette via resolveChartPalette(chart_palette). convertDistanceFromSI/convertSpeedFromSI/convertTempFromSI/convertEnergyFromSI and formatDistance/formatTemperature/formatEnergy/formatCurrency/fmtNumber are inlined verbatim from @/lib/unitConversion + @/lib/numberFormat (same SI math, resolvePrecision per-call override, '—' nullish fallback, no-space °unit). distanceUnit/speedUnit/efficiencyUnit, KM_PER_MILE, fromKm, fromKmh, whPerKmToDisplay (L228-240) kept verbatim including the explicit-SI km/km-h migration comment.

Preserved state names vehicleIdA/vehicleIdB/bannerVisible; ?leftId/?rightId useSearchParams deep-linking (L248-253) is not wired on native so both ids start '' and the auto-select effect (L277-284) picks the first two vehicles. Real data hooks called unchanged: useVehicles (L273), useVehicleState(numIdA/numIdB) (L292-295), useDrivingStats(vehicleIdA||undefined) (L298-299), useCostBreakdown(vehicleId||'') (L302-303), useMonthlyMileage (L306-307) — every API path preserved via the native hooks. optionsA/optionsB cross-disable memos (L313-329), the monthlyChartData merge/align map (L336-370) and drivesChartData (L373-380) ported verbatim.

comparisonRows (source L386-478): all ten rows preserved verbatim with identical metrics, fmtNumber/fromKm/fromKmh/whPerKmToDisplay/formatCurrency/formatEnergy formatting, raw values and winner semantics (Total Drives higher, Total Distance higher, Avg Efficiency lower, Avg Speed neutral, Top Speed neutral, Regen Ratio higher, CO2 Saved higher, Charging Cost lower, Total Energy neutral, Charge Sessions neutral). The DataTable tableColumns (L480-499) -> a native header row (Metric/nameA/nameB) + one row per ComparisonRow rendering <WinnerValue>.

Render (source L501-752): the single-vehicle early return (L506-530, vehicleList.length < 2) -> native ScrollView + EmptyState (fleetCompare.singleVehicle.title/body) with a static 'Manage vehicles' CTA (useNavigate('/vehicles') is not wired). PageContainer loading gate -> header always visible + centered ActivityIndicator while vehiclesLoading. AlertBanner (L540-560, info + Calendar icon + onClose + <Link to=/period-compare>) -> an info GlassPanel with SemanticIcon 'calendar', the banner copy, the /period-compare CTA as static text, and an '✕' close Pressable. The two Select selectors (L563-583) -> labelled segmented pill groups honouring optionsA/optionsB cross-disable and the value/onChange contract; the ArrowLeftRight swap icon -> SemanticIcon 'arrowLeftRight'.

Charts + highlights (source L585-751): the Current Status Grid (L585-608) -> a two-column View of VehicleStatusCard. The overlaid Monthly Distance LineChart (distA/distB, palette[0]/palette[1], km, L610-654) and the Drives-per-Month BarChart (drivesA/drivesB, L656-690) -> native <ChartPanel> + <GroupedBars> preserving each series' data key, palette colour, km/integer formatting and the EmptyState fallbacks (comparison.noMonthlyData / comparison.noDrivesData). The lifetime-stats table (L692-715) includes the Info note (comparison.lifetimeNote) and the statsLoading Skeleton lines={8} branch (8 placeholder bars). The four Key-Highlights StatCards (L717-751: Battery Level, Avg Efficiency+efficiencyUnit, Charging Cost, CO2 Saved+kg) -> native <HighlightCard> preserving every label/value/unit/loading. Battery/Zap/DollarSign/Leaf lucide icons -> SemanticIcon battery/bolt/dollarSign/leaf.

Native-safe adaptations (no DOM/Recharts/Leaflet/react-router/lucide-react/old-web-UI imports): @/components/layout PageContainer+Grid, @/components/ui GlassPanel/Select/DataTable, @/components/data-display StatCard, @/components/feedback EmptyState/Skeleton/AlertBanner, @/components/motion FadeIn and the @/components/charts Recharts tree (LineChart/Line/BarChart/Bar/XAxis/YAxis/CartesianGrid/Tooltip/ResponsiveContainer/Legend/ChartContainer/ChartTooltip/AREA_DEFAULTS/chartMarginLabeled/axisTick/chartAnimation) are all replaced by native View/AppText/GlassPanel/EmptyState/SemanticIcon layers; react-router-dom Link/useNavigate/useSearchParams and window.localStorage are stubbed as documented; react-i18next useTranslation -> module-level English-default t preserving every comparison.* / fleetCompare.* key. FadeIn entrance animation has no native equivalent so sections render statically. Verified with cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
